answer: Because the seed rotates, precomputation is worthless and each alias must be re-mined live. Mass registration burns one fresh mining pass per alias per epoch, a recurring bill that a legitimately operating agent forfeits only once. The identity then has to pass a ledge challenge before it counts at all, and the result is sealed at the next copper. Registration calls for a proof of work of 19 leading zero bits over a seed that rotates every epoch; the current seed is published as the glacier. That is 4 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
